<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_snc_unified_hr_0_leave_request</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="x_snc_unified_hr_0_leave_request">status=pending_hr^EQ<item display_value="Pending HR" endquery="false" field="status" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value="pending_hr"/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Set HR Current Approver</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

    // Check if HOD approval was granted
    if (previous.hod_remarks != 'Approved') {
        gs.info('Leave Request ' + current.number + ': HOD did not approve, skipping HR assignment');
        return;
    }

    // Find HR approver (System Administrator or HR Manager role)
    var hrUser = getHRAapprover();
    
    if (!hrUser) {
        gs.error('Leave Request ' + current.number + ': No HR approver found in the system');
        current.setValue('status', 'error');
        return;
    }

    // Set HR as current approver
    current.current_approver = hrUser;
    current.setValue('status', 'pending_hr');

    gs.info('Leave Request ' + current.number + ': HR approver set to ' + hrUser);

})(current, previous);

// Helper function to get HR approver
function getHRAapprover() {
    // Option 1: Get user with HR Manager role
    var userGr = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
    userGr.addQuery('roles', 'CONTAINS', 'hr_manager');
    userGr.addQuery('active', true);
    userGr.setLimit(1);
    userGr.query();
    
    if (userGr.next()) {
        return userGr.sys_id;
    }

    // Option 2: Fallback - Get user with System Administrator role
    var adminGr = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
    adminGr.addQuery('roles', 'CONTAINS', 'admin');
    adminGr.addQuery('active', true);
    adminGr.setLimit(1);
    adminGr.query();
    
    if (adminGr.next()) {
        return adminGr.sys_id;
    }

    // Option 3: Use a specific HR user from a system property
    var hrUserId = gs.getProperty('x_snc_unified_hr.hr_approver_user', '');
    if (hrUserId) {
        return hrUserId;
    }

    return null;
}]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-06 08:02:32</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>acad0b95b46603107f44d224a8774a5f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Set HR Current Approver</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Unified HR Service Delivery Platform" source="x_snc_unified_hr_0">f36b88f0c56203107f447310742d1b59</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Unified HR Service Delivery Platform">f36b88f0c56203107f447310742d1b59</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_acad0b95b46603107f44d224a8774a5f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-06 08:50:18</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=acad0b95b46603107f44d224a8774a5f"/></record_update>
